name: mow-web-vercel-root
description: Placeholder root package.json for Vercel, whose project Root Directory setting still points here (at mood-of-wood-staff-pilot/) rather than at frontend/. This has no dependencies of its own — its only job is to exist so `npm install` at this level succeeds, and to define vercel-build so Vercel's actual build happens inside frontend/. See vercel.json alongside this file.

scripts.vercel-build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
